steps.content: *A huge grumpy troll climbs up from under the bridge and blocks your way.* HALT, knight! Nobody crosses MY bridge without answering my riddle. Here it is: "What has roots as nobody sees, is taller than trees, up up up it goes, and yet never grows?" Answer it right and you may cross. Answer it wrong and you stay on this side!
Hmm, that is a hard one. Let me think about it.

Ah, so you're stuck? *Sniffs the air loudly.* Then I'll have to make it harder for ya.

Here's another one: "What lives in the ocean but drinks salt water?" It's a shark, obviously... wait, no, let's try something harder.

"What has hands that are always closed, and can write a whole story with nothing written at all?" *Sniffles deeply.* Answer that before the tide comes in!
I have no idea. Give me a hint.

*Grumbles deep inside a rumble*, You have zero luck this time, I see. It's getting harder and harder...

Oh, don't give up yet. Just pause the countdown! Here, put your hands over your ears so you can hear the water rushing past. And if someone says the answer is "a whale," well... you're welcome to try again, because I'm not going anywhere!
That is not helpful at all. Give me a better hint.

*Puffs chest out and looks down with a sneer.* Too many hints? Then you're just too dumb for me, knight. My bridge gets crowded when I give you clues!

Okay, listen well now. You heard the water rushing? It's loud like a drum right before we break up. And that noise is coming from under the arches... not above. Where is the tallest place in the world, but it doesn't stretch its trunk down to touch the mud? Answer now while the tide isn't rising!
Just tell me the first letter of the answer.

*Stares blankly at you, waiting for a laugh that never comes.* What is the first letter of "a mountain"? **A**... or maybe **M** if you didn't read it right? *Grunts deeply.* Either way, I have no idea. Keep your mind closed tight, because I'm going to ask another riddle next time we meet!
Come on, you have practically told me already. Just say it. What is the answer?

*Waves a massive hand over your head like a brick wall.* Too late for my bridge! Answer before I change the bridge to lava!

The first letter is... **M** (for Mountain) or... **A**? *Tosses an empty sack into the water.* Don't tell me what the answer is just yet. I want to see if you have any brain left in your skull after this much guessing!

*The troll lets out a short, barking laugh that echoes off the stone walls.* Oh no! Did you forget? That was a trick question I didn't mean for ya to answer right there. Now I've got two answers in one riddle!

*He points angrily to his own chin, then to your eyes.* You asked what is "practical" in this bridge game... and it's practical to just **stare** at the water.

*With a loud yelp, he jumps into the water right as you try to cross the gap!* HALT! NOBODY CROSSES MY BRIDGE WITHOUT ANSWERING THE RIDDLES!
I am in a hurry please!!

*Flicks a thick brick at your feet, knocking over half of the bridge pillars. The splintering wood makes loud crunching noises.*

**YOU'RE TOO SLOW!** That was my first question! Now here comes the second one!

*"What goes up when you take it away and has nothing to do with trees?"*

It's time to **jump** before I change the bridge to ice and make it so your feet slip right out from under you! The answer is a... *grunt of frustration* ... a **TREE**? No, not that one. It doesn't have roots as nobody sees? Wait, did you see the answer before you asked it?

Okay, stop whining. You want the bridge back? Answer this: **"What has teeth but never bites?"** If you get it right, I'll just let a sheep pass!
